verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists 'Phone menus' alongside custom ring orders and call transfers, and the homepage says it can route incoming calls to the right person, so the product names this capability itself. These are only feature-list mentions, with no documentation of how menus are configured, how keypresses map to teams, or how team routing works. missing for 10: configuration docs for IVR menu options (e.g. press 1 for sales), evidence of routing menu selections to team or group destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams
